# oauth2_relay — OAuth2 client_credentials + GraphQL Relay pagination
# Verifies: the runner fetches an OAuth2 token, then POSTs the GraphQL query
# to /oauth2_relay/graphql with variables.after driven by relay_cursor.
# PageSize=2, EventsPerDrain=5 → 3 pages (2 + 2 + 1) of relay-style cursor
# pagination; pageInfo.hasNextPage drives termination on page 3.
# The token endpoint is handled by the auth layer (not traced as an exchange).
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml oauth2_relay
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --

{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":2,"method":"POST","request_body":"body 217 bytes, object-like","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>","Content-Type":"application/json"},"response_body":"body 221 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/oauth2_relay/graphql"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":3,"method":"POST","request_body":"body 217 bytes, object-like","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>","Content-Type":"application/json"},"response_body":"body 148 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/oauth2_relay/graphql"}
